notes.title: Demo Update: New Localizations Added. Gameplay Mechanics Improved
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266666/4c83ea1d03676a2addc2ea1c0f9bdfdc68411593.jpg
Hello!

The demo version has received another update.
We’ve added new localizations and made several improvements to make the gameplay more comfortable and clear.

Full list of changes:

 Added translations for the following languages: German, French, Spanish, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Chinese (Simplified), Turkish.
 Turn order of combat participants is now displayed in battles.
 Choice buttons in quests now show an icon of the attribute affecting party members' loyalty change.
 Generated quest titles now indicate their difficulty level.


At this stage, we are making changes to the full version of the game as well as the playtest version. This includes improvements to the turn-based combat system.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180010/Blades_For_Hire_Demo/

You can always reach out to our team with any questions:
We invite you to join our Discord server.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Greetings!

We're grateful for all the feedback we've received from players, as well as from those who shared their playthroughs and livestreams.

We've prepared the first round of fixes, and they are now available in the current demo version:

Changes:


 Selected mercenary tactic is now saved between battles. You won’t have to choose the same tactic over and over again.
 Resting mercenaries now recover health continuously, rather than just once per day.
 Increased the chance of generating a mage recruit each week.
 The starting quest has been moved to a neighboring town so that new players can immediately learn how to navigate the map.
 Tweaked the timing of loot distribution event after the "The Warehouse Heist" quest.
 Adjusted the difficulty of the final quest.

Fixes:


 Dagger-wielding enemies can no longer attack from the back row while ignoring their front row allies (they can still ignore obstructing player characters, as originally intended).
 Fixed interface display issues on UltraWide monitors.
 Fixed incorrect display of available training options.
 Characters that leave due to low loyalty are now instantly removed from the Storage window.
 The temporary effect "Lacerations" now correctly reduces healing speed by 50%.
 Fixed an error caused by clicking through quest steps too quickly.
 Fixed an error caused by "Hymn of the Invincible" tactic.


Very soon, we’ll launch playtests open to everyone, which will include all the current fixes. Based on the results of the playtests, we’ll make the final adjustments and begin preparing for release!

If you have any questions for the team, don’t hesitate to ask —
we’d love to hear from you on our Discord server.
